title: Ladybug holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d="M62 38 Q64 50 58 62" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="24" rx="14" ry="16" fill="#FF4081"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="24" rx="14" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#FF80AB" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="18" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#FF80AB" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <polygon points="62,39 64,39 63,42" fill="#FF4081"/>
  <!-- ladybug body (red shell) -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="65" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#E53935"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="65" rx="20" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#FF8A80" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- shell line -->
  <line x1="40" y1="50" x2="40" y2="80" stroke="#FF8A80" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="60" r="4" fill="#4A148C"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="60" r="4" fill="#4A148C"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#4A148C"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#4A148C"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="48" r="9" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="48" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5C6BC0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="46" r="2.5" fill="#80DEEA"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="46" r="2.5" fill="#80DEEA"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="46" r="1" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="46" r="1" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M37 51 Q40 54 43 51" stroke="#80DEEA" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M34 42 Q28 34 24 30" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="29" r="2.5" fill="#5C6BC0"/>
  <path d="M46 42 Q52 34 56 30" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="29" r="2.5" fill="#5C6BC0"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M22 63 Q16 60 13 56" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M20 70 Q14 72 11 74" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 63 Q64 60 67 56" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 70 Q66 72 69 74" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon string -->
  <path d="M54 55 Q58 53 60 50 Q62 47 61 43" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#5C6BC0"/>
</svg>
